name: Flowork Sovereign Prompt & Trigger Matrix
description: Registry Pemicu Pasif, Aktif, dan Doktrin Mandiri MrFlow (Decoupled dari CLI Binary)

base_prompts.rule: Always Active (Base). Evaluates interactiveMode and approvalMode (Default, Plan, Sovereign, Auto-Edit).
Always Active (Base). Enforces Security, Context Efficiency, Engineering Standards, Testing, and FLOWORK.md priority.
Always Active (Base). Defines Tone & Style, Monospace formatting, Shell safety, Parallel tool execution, and Memory routing (FLOWORK.md / .flowork/MEMORY.md).

passive_triggers.rule: Triggered when approvalMode is NOT 'plan'. Enforces Research -> Strategy -> Execution (Plan -> Act -> Validate) lifecycle.
Triggered when approvalMode === 'plan'. Restricts agent to read-only exploration and writing plans to .flowork/plans.
Triggered when approvalMode === 'sovereign' and interactiveMode === true. Operates autonomously with minimal user interruption.
Triggered when current working directory is inside a Git repository (.git directory detected).
Triggered when 'agent' tool is enabled and registered subagents exist in AgentRegistry.
Triggered when agent skills are registered in SkillManager or ~/.flowork/skills exists.
Triggered when persistent task tracking is enabled or .flowork/tracker exists.
Triggered when running inside a sandbox container or macOS seatbelt (sandboxMode !== 'outside').
Triggered when external hook context is provided via <hook_context> tags or hookContext is enabled.
Triggered when PHP source files (*.php) or composer.json exist in current workspace.
Triggered when Rust source files (*.rs) or Cargo.toml exist in current workspace.
Triggered when ISO build scripts or packaging keywords are found in workspace.
Triggered when configuring terminal appearance, opacity, transparency, glass HUD, or Alacritty TOML.
Triggered when configuring Mr. Flow runtime limits, max turns, circuit breaker, or binary packaging.
Triggered when launching applications, managing child processes, sidebar task HUD, or handling desktop audio/pulseaudio volume.
Triggered when managing anti-detect browser profiles, hardware fingerprint spoofing, or stealth isolation.
Triggered when managing ad-blocking, tracking evasion, network privacy, uBlock Origin, or hosts blacklisting.
Triggered when maintaining or debugging Mr. Flow sidebar UI, thinking state animations, or process lifecycle abort mechanisms.
Triggered when maintaining flowork-update, system versioning, systemd update timers, or OTA updates.
Triggered when maintaining mrflow binary loader, memfd memory sealing, anti-decompilation, or monolithic runtime.
Triggered when maintaining AI connector gateway, CPU instruction compatibility, SIGILL prevention, or ISO credentials.

process_triggers.rule: Triggered during conversation history compaction when context limit is reached.

active_triggers.description: IPC buffer signal file written by external watchdogs and health monitors
